2.3.17 Report.DefaultFontFamily
Applies to RDL 2016/01
The Report.DefaultFontFamily element specifies the font family that is used for all text that is
rendered when an explicit font is not defined in the Style.FontFamily element of any child report item.
The Report.DefaultFontFamily element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a
String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1). If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as
"Arial". If the value of this element is not a recognized font family, its value is interpreted as "Arial".
Following is the parent element of the Report.DefaultFontFamily element.
Parent elements
Report
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Report.DefaultFontFamily element.
 <xsd:element name="DefaultFontFamily" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0"
xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/reporting/2016/01/reportdefinition/defaultfontf
amily" />
